End Users.Title: User Account Management
End Users.Description: Provide functionalities for users to create and manage their accounts, enabling secure SignUp and SignIn processes, and allowing users to update and edit their profile information post-login.

User Stories.Title: User Registration
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to register an account so that I can securely access personalized features of the web application.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can fill out a registration form with name, email, and password.
Input validation to ensure email format and password strength.
Confirmation email is sent to the user upon successful registration.
User data is stored securely in the database.

User Stories.Title: User Login
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to log into my account using my credentials so that I can access my personal and application-specific data securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can login using email and password.
System validates credentials against stored data.
Error message displayed if login fails.
Session management to keep the user logged in during interaction.

User Stories.Title: Profile Editing
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to edit my profile information after logging in so that I can keep my personal information up to date.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can access a form to edit profile details such as name and email.
Changes are saved and updated immediately in the database.
User receives confirmation that profile has been updated.

User Stories.Title: Password Update
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to change my password so that I can maintain the security of my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can initiate a password change request from their profile.
User must verify their current password before setting a new one.
Input validation for new password strength.
Confirmation message displayed upon successful password update.

User Stories.Title: Account Recovery
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to recover my account using my registered email in case I forget my login credentials so that I can regain access to my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can request password reset via email.
User receives an email with a link to reset password.
User can set a new password using the link.
Confirmation of password reset is communicated to the user.

End Users.Title: Wishlist Creation and Management
End Users.Description: Enable authenticated users to create and manage a personal wishlist, adding and modifying items or interests as desired within their user profile.

User Stories.Title: User Registration
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to register an account so that I can securely access and personalize my wishlist.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can input name, email, and password to create an account.
System validates the data to ensure it meets security standards.
Upon successful registration, a confirmation email is sent to the user.
The user can proceed to log in after confirming their email.

User Stories.Title: User Login
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to log into my account so that I can access my personal wishlist.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can log in using their email and password.
System authenticates the credentials and grants access.
If the credentials are incorrect, the user is informed and can attempt to log in again.
Successful login redirects the user to their profile page.

User Stories.Title: Edit User Profile
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to edit my profile so that I can update my personal information as needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: User can access a 'Edit Profile' section after logging in.
User can update fields such as name, email, and profile picture.
Changes are saved immediately upon user confirmation.
System provides a confirmation message upon successful update.

User Stories.Title: Create Wishlist
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to create a personal wishlist so that I can keep track of items or interests I desire.
AcceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can access a 'Create Wishlist' feature from their profile.
Users can add items with details such as item name, description, and optional images or links.
Users can save the wishlist, which is then viewable and editable within their profile.
The system confirms the creation of the wishlist with a message.

User Stories.Title: Manage Wishlist
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to modify and delete items in my wishlist so that it stays current with my interests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can view their current wishlist from their profile.
Users can edit or delete any item on their wishlist.
Modifications are saved and reflected immediately in the system.
The system provides a confirmation upon successful modification or deletion.

End Users.Title: Landing Page Development
End Users.Description: Develop a visually appealing and informative landing page that effectively guides users to SignUp or SignIn, and provides direct access to edit profile and create wishlist functionalities.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Landing Page Design
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want the landing page to be visually appealing and intuitive so that I feel welcomed and can easily navigate to SignUp or SignIn.
AcceptanceCriteria: The landing page must load within 3 seconds.
Include visual elements that are aesthetically pleasing.
Buttons for SignUp and SignIn are clearly visible and accessible.
Responsive design to ensure accessibility on various devices (desktop, tablet, mobile).

User Stories.Title: User Story: SignUp Functionality
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to easily register for an account from the landing page so that I can access personalized features.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provide a clear and concise SignUp form accessible from the landing page.
The SignUp process requires minimal steps to enhance user convenience.
Required fields are clearly indicated, with tooltips for information about the inputs.
Upon successful registration, a confirmation email is sent.

User Stories.Title: User Story: SignIn Functionality
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to securely log into my account from the landing page so that I can access my personalized settings and wishlist.
AcceptanceCriteria: Include a SignIn form on the landing page.
The form should include fields for username and password.
Provide an option to view the password as it is being typed.
Implement secure handling of credentials.
Display error messages for incorrect inputs.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Direct Access to Edit Profile
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to navigate directly to the Edit Profile page from the landing page after logging in so that I can easily update my personal information.
AcceptanceCriteria: After SignIn, provide a direct link or button to 'Edit Profile'.
Ensure the 'Edit Profile' page allows for editing all relevant user details.
Changes should be savable with a single action.
Users receive visual confirmation of successful updates.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Create Wishlist Access
User Stories.Description: As an End User, I want to be able to directly access and create a wishlist from the landing page so that I can personalize my experience and save items of interest.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provide a prominent feature on the landing page post-login for 'Create Wishlist'.
Allow users to add items to their wishlist easily.
Ensure the wishlist can be viewed and modified at any time.
Provide options to save or clear the wishlist.

Business Owners.Title: User Account Management
Business Owners.Description: Develop secure and intuitive user account management functionalities including SignUp and SignIn, allowing users to register, access, and manage their accounts, thus driving user engagement and platform security.

User Stories.Title: User Registration
User Stories.Description: As a new user, I want to be able to sign up for an account so that I can access personalized features and maintain my privacy.
AcceptanceCriteria: The SignUp page must include fields for name, email, and password.
Passwords must be encrypted before storage.
A confirmation email is sent to the user after successful registration.
An error message is displayed if the signup fails due to an existing email address.

User Stories.Title: User Login
User Stories.Description: As a returning user, I want to be able to sign in using my email and password so that I can access my account securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: The SignIn page must authenticate users by their email and encrypted password.
Users are redirected to their profile page upon successful login.
An error message is displayed for incorrect login credentials.
Session timeout must be implemented for security.

User Stories.Title: Edit User Profile
User Stories.Description: As a logged-in user, I want to be able to edit my profile details so that I can keep my personal information up to date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Logged-in users can access an Edit Profile page with pre-populated fields of current information.
Users can update their name, email, and profile picture.
Changes are saved immediately upon user confirmation.
Users receive a confirmation notification upon successful update.

User Stories.Title: Create User Wishlist
User Stories.Description: As a logged-in user, I want to create and manage a wishlist so that I can save items or services I am interested in for future reference.
AcceptanceCriteria: Logged-in users can access a 'Create Wishlist' feature from their profile.
Users can add items to their wishlist and remove them as needed.
The wishlist must update in real-time as items are added or removed.
Users can view their complete wishlist at any time.

User Stories.Title: Landing Page Accessibility
User Stories.Description: As a user, I want to be able to navigate easily from the landing page to SignUp, SignIn, and other functionalities so that I can utilize the application smoothly.
AcceptanceCriteria: The landing page must clearly display options for SignUp and SignIn.
Links to 'Edit Profile' and 'Create Wishlist' should be accessible post-login.
The landing page should load within 3 seconds to ensure a quick access time.
The design should be responsive for accessibility across devices.

User Stories.Title: Data Security and Compliance
User Stories.Description: As a Business Owner, I want all user data to be handled securely in compliance with relevant laws and regulations to protect the business from legal issues and to maintain user trust.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data transmission must be secured using HTTPS.
Compliance with GDPR and other relevant privacy laws must be ensured.
Regular security audits are conducted to identify and rectify vulnerabilities.
Encryption standards like AES or bcrypt are used for storing sensitive user data.

Business Owners.Title: User Profile Customization
Business Owners.Description: Create functionalities for users to edit and update their profiles post-registration, enabling personalized user experiences which can improve user satisfaction and retention.

User Stories.Title: User Profile Update Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a registered user, I want to update my profile information, so that I can keep my personal data up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can access their profile via a secure login.
Users can edit fields such as name, email, and profile picture.
Changes must be saved and immediately visible upon the user session refresh.
There should be a confirmation message after successful update.
The system should handle errors and provide meaningful messages if updates fail.

User Stories.Title: Profile Customization Options
User Stories.Description: As a registered user, I want to customize additional elements of my profile, such as a custom username and a bio, so that I can personalize my user experience on the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can edit customizable fields like username and bio from their profile settings.
The changes should be immediately reflected in the user's profile view to others.
Input fields should have validation to prevent inappropriate content.
Provide tooltips or helper text to guide users through the customization options.

User Stories.Title: Privacy Settings Management
User Stories.Description: As a registered user, I want to manage my privacy settings, so that I can control the visibility of my profile information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users should have a section in their profile for privacy settings.
Options to make certain information public or private must be available (e.g., email, phone number).
Changes should take effect immediately.
System should confirm privacy settings updates with the user.

User Stories.Title: Profile Data Security Enhancement
User Stories.Description: As a business owner, I want the user profile data to be securely handled, so that user trust is maintained thereby increasing retention.
AcceptanceCriteria: Profile edits and data transmission are secured via HTTPS.
Implement data encryption for sensitive user data stored in the database.
Regular security audits and compliance checks must be performed.
Users are notified of the privacy and security measures in place through the user interface.

User Stories.Title: Comprehensive User Profile Analytics
User Stories.Description: As a business owner, I want to analyze user profile updates, so that I can understand user behavior and preferences to improve marketing strategies.
AcceptanceCriteria: System should log all profile update activities.
Analytics dashboard should represent data through charts and graphs.
Data should be filterable by date, type of change, and user demographics.
Dashboard must be accessible only by authorized personnel.

Business Owners.Title: Wishlist Creation
Business Owners.Description: Implement a feature for users to create and manage personalized wishlists, enhancing user interaction and engagement with the platform, which can lead to increased user retention and satisfaction.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Wishlist Creation
User Stories.Description: As a user, I want to create a personalized wishlist so that I can save items I am interested in for future reference or purchase.
AcceptanceCriteria: User must be logged in to access the wishlist creation feature.
User should be able to add items to the wishlist from the product catalog.
User should be able to name the wishlist and provide a description.
The system must save the wishlist persistently so that it can be accessed in future sessions.
The system should provide a confirmation message once the wishlist is created.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Wishlist Management
User Stories.Description: As a user, I want to manage my existing wishlists so that I can update items, rename, or delete my wishlist as needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: User must be logged in to modify a wishlist.
User should be able to add or remove items from the wishlist.
User should be able to rename the wishlist and change its description.
User should be able to delete a wishlist with a confirmation prompt to prevent accidental deletions.
Changes to the wishlist should be updated in real-time and stored persistently.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Wishlist Sharing
User Stories.Description: As a user, I want to share my wishlist with friends or family so that they can view the items I've saved.
AcceptanceCriteria: User must be logged in to share a wishlist.
The system should generate a shareable link that the user can send to others.
Recipients of the link should be able to view the wishlist without needing to log in.
The shareable link should be secure and should not allow unauthorized editing of the wishlist.
The system should provide an option to revoke the shared link.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Wishlist Visibility Settings
User Stories.Description: As a user, I want to set visibility options for my wishlists so that I can control who can see my wishlists.
AcceptanceCriteria: User must be logged in to set wishlist visibility.
User should be able to set the wishlist as public, private, or visible only to specific people.
If set to specific people, the system should allow users to select friends or enter email addresses to grant access.
Changes to visibility settings should be applied immediately and persistently saved.
The system should ensure that privacy settings are respected in all views and shared links.

User Stories.Title: User Story: Business Analytics for Wishlists
User Stories.Description: As a business owner, I want to access analytics on user wishlists so that I can understand customer preferences and plan my inventory accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Business owners must have administrative access to view analytics.
Analytics should include data on the most added items, frequently shared wishlists, and user engagement with wishlists.
The system should provide options to filter analytics by date range, product category, and user demographics.
Data should be presented in a clear, visual format such as graphs and charts.
The analytics feature should comply with privacy regulations, ensuring that user-specific data is anonymized.

Business Owners.Title: Landing Page Development
Business Owners.Description: Design and implement an inviting and informative landing page that directs users efficiently to either sign up, sign in, or access their profiles and wishlists, thereby increasing conversion rates and enhancing user experience.

User Stories.Title: Landing Page Design
User Stories.Description: As a Business Owner, I want the landing page to have a visually appealing and clear design that highlights the SignUp, SignIn, Edit Profile, and Create Wishlist features, so that new and returning users are encouraged to interact with the site, leading to higher engagement and conversion rates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Landing page must include visible call-to-action buttons for SignUp and SignIn.
Include separate links or buttons for returning users to access their profiles and wishlists directly.
Design must be responsive to work across various devices and screen sizes.
Landing page loads within 3 seconds to ensure quick access.

User Stories.Title: User SignUp
User Stories.Description: As a Business Owner, I want the website to offer an easy and secure SignUp process on the landing page, so that new users can effortlessly create accounts, thereby increasing user growth and expanding the customer base.
AcceptanceCriteria: SignUp form is accessible from the main landing page.
Form includes fields for name, email, and password.
All data entries must be validated for format and completeness before submission.
Submission of the signup form leads to a verification email being sent to the user’s provided email address.

User Stories.Title: User SignIn
User Stories.Description: As a Business Owner, I want the website to enable a secure SignIn option on the landing page, so that returning users can easily access their profiles and wishlists, promoting frequent user engagement.
AcceptanceCriteria: SignIn form is accessible from the main landing page.
Includes fields for email and password.
Must include a 'Forgot password?' link.
Correct credentials allow access to the user's dashboard.
Invalid login attempts provide a clear error message without revealing which element (email or password) was incorrect.

User Stories.Title: Profile and Wishlist Access
User Stories.Description: As a Business Owner, I want returning users to be able to access their profile and wishlist directly from the landing page after signing in, so that they can easily manage their personal information and preferences, enhancing user satisfaction and retention.
AcceptanceCriteria: Direct links to 'Edit Profile' and 'Create Wishlist' are visible and accessible post-login.
Users can update personal information and save changes with immediate effect.
Users can add, modify, and delete items in their wishlist smoothly.

User Stories.Title: Analytics Integration on Landing Page
User Stories.Description: As a Business Owner, I want to integrate analytics on the landing page, so that we can track user interactions with the SignUp, SignIn, and other features, enabling us to gather data to further optimize the user experience and increase conversions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with a web analytics tool like Google Analytics.
Track clicks on SignUp, SignIn, Edit Profile, and Create Wishlist.
Regular reports are generated showing user interaction metrics.
Data privacy regulations compliance must be ensured while collecting data.

System Administrators.Title: User Management System
System Administrators.Description: Develop a robust user management system to handle SignUp, SignIn, and user authentication processes, ensuring secure access controls and management capabilities for administrators.

User Stories.Title: Admin Dashboard Access
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to access a dedicated admin dashboard so that I can manage all user accounts and their activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin login credentials must be validated securely.
The dashboard must display user account status, recent activity, and management options.
The dashboard must be accessible only to users with administrator privileges.

User Stories.Title: User Account Management
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to have the ability to activate, deactivate, or delete user accounts so that I can ensure proper access control and compliance with our policies.
AcceptanceCriteria: Options to activate, deactivate, or delete accounts must be clearly accessible in the admin dashboard.
Changes made by the administrator should be reflected immediately in the system.
All changes must be logged for audit purposes.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to assign roles to users and modify them as necessary so that users have appropriate access to system functionalities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Administrators should be able to assign, modify, or revoke roles through the admin dashboard.
The system must enforce access restrictions based on user roles.
Any role changes should be updated in real-time and logged for auditing.

User Stories.Title: Audit Logs
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to view and export audit logs so that I can monitor changes and access patterns to ensure security compliance.
AcceptanceCriteria: Audit logs must capture all user activities including logins, role changes, and profile updates.
Logs must be viewable through the admin dashboard and exportable in common file formats.
Logs should be stored securely and retain data according to compliance requirements.

User Stories.Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup for Admins
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to enable two-factor authentication for administrative accounts to enhance the security of sensitive operations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Two-factor authentication must be configurable through the admin dashboard.
Once enabled, it should require a secondary verification method (e.g., SMS, email, authenticator app) in addition to the password.
There should be support for backup codes in case the primary two-factor method is unavailable.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to receive real-time notifications for critical user actions such as failed login attempts or role changes so that I can respond promptly to potential security incidents.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications must be configurable in terms of types of actions that trigger alerts.
Notifications should be delivered via email and/or SMS to the administrator.
Each notification should provide sufficient details about the action to enable quick assessment and response.

System Administrators.Title: Profile Management System
System Administrators.Description: Implement a system that allows administrators to manage and oversee user profile information, including the ability to edit, update, or remove user profiles as necessary.

User Stories.Title: Admin Profile Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to have the ability to access and view all user profiles so that I can oversee and manage user information effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can log into a secure admin panel.
Admin can view a list of all registered user profiles.
Admin can select any user profile to view detailed information.
Ensure security and confidentiality of user data during access.

User Stories.Title: Edit User Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the capability to edit user profiles so that I can update information on behalf of users when necessary.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a user profile and edit fields such as name, email, etc.
Changes are saved and immediately reflected in the user's profile.
Admin receives a confirmation notification upon successful update.
User receives a notification that their profile has been updated by an administrator.

User Stories.Title: Disable User Accounts
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to disable user accounts so that I can restrict access when users violate terms of service.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a user profile and disable the user’s account.
Disabled accounts cannot log in or access the application.
Admin receives a confirmation notification upon successful account disabling.
User receives an email notification about their account status change.

User Stories.Title: Delete User Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the option to delete user profiles so that I can remove users who no longer wish to use our platform or have requested account deletion.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can permanently delete a user's profile from the database.
Ensure that all data related to the user is completely removed.
Admin receives a confirmation notification upon successful deletion.
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations concerning user data deletion.

User Stories.Title: Audit User Activities
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor and audit user activities so that I can ensure compliance with policy and detect any suspicious behavior.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can view logs of user activities such as login times and changes made to profiles.
System maintains a secure and tamper-proof log of all user activities.
Admin can generate reports based on activity logs for audit and compliance purposes.

System Administrators.Title: Wishlist Management Module
System Administrators.Description: Create a module that enables administrators to manage user wishlists, including adding, editing, or deleting wishlist items, and to oversee how these lists are used and managed within the application.

User Stories.Title: Admin View Wishlist
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to view all user wishlists so that I can oversee the overall wishlist content and ensure it adheres to community guidelines.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can view a list of all wishlists.
Admin can select any user's wishlist to view its details.
Admin can see the timestamp of the last update for each wishlist.
Ensure that the viewing interface is user-friendly and displays relevant information clearly.

User Stories.Title: Admin Add Wishlist Items
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to add items to any user's wishlist so that I can assist in managing content when necessary.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can select a user and add items to the user's wishlist.
The system should verify the admin's permissions before allowing the addition.
Admin must be able to search and select items to add using a search interface.
The system should confirm the addition with the admin and optionally notify the user.

User Stories.Title: Admin Edit Wishlist Items
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to edit items in any user's wishlist so that I can correct errors or update information as needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can select an item in a user's wishlist and edit details.
The system should provide a form to change item details such as name, description, and quantity.
Changes must be saved immediately and accurately reflect in the system.
The system should log all changes made by the administrator for auditing purposes.

User Stories.Title: Admin Delete Wishlist Items
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the ability to delete items from any user's wishlist so that I can remove inappropriate or outdated items as necessary.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can select an item in any user's wishlist and delete it.
The system should ask for confirmation before deleting the item.
Deleted items should be removed from the list instantly and no longer be retrievable.
The system should log the deletion and notify the user if configurated.

User Stories.Title: Admin Audit Wishlist Changes
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to view a history of all changes made to wishlists so that I can monitor activity and revert any inappropriate modifications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin must be able to access a log of all edits, additions, and deletions made to wishlists.
The log should include details such as the type of change, who made the change, and the time of the change.
Admin should have the ability to filter the log by user, date, and type of change.
The system should allow admins to revert changes directly from the audit log.

User Stories.Title: Admin Manage Wishlist Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to configure notifications for changes to wishlists so that users can be informed of modifications by the admin team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin can enable or disable notifications for specific types of wishlist changes such as additions, deletions, or modifications.
The system should offer customizable templates for notifications sent to users.
Notifications must be sent automatically based on admin settings.
Admin should be able to review a log of all sent notifications.

System Administrators.Title: Security and Compliance Enforcement
System Administrators.Description: Ensure the web application adheres to relevant security standards and data protection regulations, implementing necessary security measures to protect user data and system integrity.

User Stories.Title: Implement Secure Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to implement secure authentication mechanisms so that user credentials are protected against unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: Authentication uses a secure hash algorithm for password storage.
Implements multi-factor authentication for added security.
Provides detailed logs of authentication attempts for monitoring.

User Stories.Title: Data Encryption at Rest and Transit
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want all sensitive user data to be encrypted both at rest and in transit so that the integrity and confidentiality of user data are maintained.
AcceptanceCriteria: All sensitive data stored in databases must be encrypted using industry-standard encryption protocols.
All data transmitted over the network must be encrypted using HTTPS or other secure protocols.
Regular audits to verify the implementation of encryption standards.

User Stories.Title: Regular Security Audits
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the application to undergo regular security audits so that any vulnerabilities can be identified and remediated promptly to maintain system security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Conduct bi-annual security audits using a reputable third-party security firm.
Audit results must be documented and reviewed by the development team.
Implement recommendations from the audit findings within a reasonable timeframe.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Access Control Implementation
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to have a robust role-based access control system so that users can only access features and data relevant to their roles, ensuring system security and data privacy.
AcceptanceCriteria: Define and implement at least three user roles with specific access rights.
Enforce access restrictions based on user roles at all points of interaction within the application.
Regularly review and update access rights as necessary.

User Stories.Title: Compliance with GDPR and Other Regulations
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to comply with GDPR and other relevant data protection regulations so that the application is legally compliant and user trust is maintained.
AcceptanceCriteria: Implement mechanisms for users to view, download, and delete their data.
Ensure all data collection and processing activities have user consent where required.
Regular training for staff on GDPR compliance and data handling procedures.

User Stories.Title: Secure System Logging and Monitoring
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want the web application to have secure logging and monitoring mechanisms so that I can track all system activities and detect potential security threats early.
AcceptanceCriteria: All logs must be encrypted and stored securely.
Implement real-time monitoring tools to detect and alert on suspicious activities.
Logs should include user actions, system errors, and access attempts.

System Administrators.Title: System Monitoring and Reporting
System Administrators.Description: Develop a comprehensive system monitoring and reporting framework that allows administrators to monitor system performance, user activities, and security logs to ensure smooth operations.

User Stories.Title: User Activity Logging
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want a feature to log all user activities so that I can review actions taken by users within the system for security and operational audits.
AcceptanceCriteria: All user actions are logged with a timestamp and user identifier.
Logs are stored securely and are accessible only to authorized administrators.
The system provides filters to view logs by user, date, and type of activity.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time System Performance Monitoring
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor system performance in real-time so that I can quickly identify and address performance bottlenecks or failures.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time performance metrics (CPU, memory usage, network status) are displayed on a dashboard.
Performance thresholds can be set, with alerts triggered when these thresholds are exceeded.
The dashboard is updated automatically without needing to refresh the page.

User Stories.Title: Security Log Monitoring
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to monitor security logs to detect any unauthorized access or potential security threats.
AcceptanceCriteria: Security logs are compiled in a central repository.
The system provides an interface to search and filter security logs by severity, date, and type of threat.
Alerts are sent to administrators in case of detected high-severity threats.

User Stories.Title: System Health Reports
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want to generate system health reports so that I can provide regular updates on system status and compliance with performance standards.
AcceptanceCriteria: Administrators can generate customizable reports on system performance and security status.
Reports can be exported in various formats (PDF, CSV, HTML).
The system stores historical report data for comparison over time.

User Stories.Title: User Activity Alert System
User Stories.Description: As a System Administrator, I want an alert system for unusual user activities so that I can take immediate action to prevent potential breaches or misuse of the system.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system analyzes user activities and flags activities that deviate from normal patterns.
Administrators receive real-time alerts of these unusual activities.
Administrators can customize the parameters that define normal vs. unusual activity.
